acceptance_criteria: Identify at least 5 major telematics insurance providers with market share data
Compare pricing models across at least 3 distinct approaches (discount-based, UBI, PHYD)
Analyze competitive moats for top 3 players with specific data points
Include OEM-embedded vs. aftermarket hardware trend analysis
Address regulatory divergence across at least 3 state regulatory frameworks
mandatory_elements: Market share data with sources cited
anti_patterns: Generic SWOT analysis without company-specific data
Recommendations that could apply to any insurance market
Market size numbers without methodology or source disclosure
Treating all telematics providers as equivalent without differentiation
